### Currencies (USD) (%)

Bonds Treasury yields were volatile during the week. Investors balanced encouraging inflation readings against resilient economic data and continued uncertainty surrounding the US-Iran conflict. June producer prices came in softer than expected, helping temporarily ease concerns about inflation and monetary policy. However, stronger-than-expected labor market data, including lower weekly jobless claims, along with continuing disruptions tied to Middle East tensions, kept upward pressure on [...] estimates. On Friday, stocks fell going into the weekend, with tech stocks leading the slide. The drop was fueled in part by new concerns regarding the sustainability of the AI sector. Overall, energy minerals, commercial services, and consumer non-durables were the top performers during the week, while communications, electronic technology, and consumer durables lagged.
